items.title: Make diagnostic help side-effect free
items.why: Both run-doctor and verify-clean-checkout ignore --help. Usage lookup starts probes or worktree verification; mutation flags can write status or invoke remediation.
items.recipe: Add early --help/-h dispatch to both existing CLIs before probes, self-test or mutations. Add actual CLI fixture tests with throwing spawn boundary and filesystem sentinels. Register in native unit/build lane; preserve normal health, self-test and worktree behavior.
items.acceptance: Both help aliases exit 0 with accurate usage, with no subprocesses or writes, including alongside --fix --loop --update-json --json --self-test and --keep --ref --from. Existing self-tests pass and normal CLI execution still crosses the probe boundary.
items.userOutcome: Operators can find the supported diagnostic/release commands without starting checks, mutating status or creating a worktree; public release reliability is preserved.
items.stageRationale: Fix a reproduced operational regression before adding product breadth.
